## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmel## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmec## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme/## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmef## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmes## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme/## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmes## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmee## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeI## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme]## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmei## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme/## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme(## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeo## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeM## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmem## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmei## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmen## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmet## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmet## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmen## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme—## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme,## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmel## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmel## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme/## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmet## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmet## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme─## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme─## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme│## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmee## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme─## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme─## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeI## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme,## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeo## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme├## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme─## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme─## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmer## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeS## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme─## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeV## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmee## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeo## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeo## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeo## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme*## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmen## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme-## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmel## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmer## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmer## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmes## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmec## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeu## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmet## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmew## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmee## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme*## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readme ## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmee## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **v4.0 Changelog**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin/blob/master/docs/Shokunin-v4.0-Changelog.pdf

## Links

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeo## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`

- **GitHub**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin
- **Docs**: github.com/EliasOulkadi/shokunin#readmeo## Memory System v4.0

The memory system uses three layers to ensure no context is lost between sessions:

1. **Agent-driven saves** — CLAUDE.md instructions force the agent to save checkpoints every 3-5 turns, and after each decision, file change, or command.
2. **Console buffer capture** — The wrapper expands the buffer to 9999 lines and reads it when OpenCode exits, absorbing anything the agent missed.
3. **Dual storage** — ChromaDB (semantic search) + markdown files (grep-able text backups).

All data is stored locally at ~/.shokunin/memory/. No cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

### Test the system
`powershell
.\test-memory.ps1
`
